_written: 2026-10-14, BEFORE any Gen52 run. Large search => high overfitting risk; the protocol separates choosing from judging.
goal: maximise prop-firm outcome: average 24-month net cash (fees paid, payouts received) buying up to 5 challenges, 1 account. Primary firm Crypto Fund Trader 1-Phase $100k; secondary FTMO 2-Step $100k (separate ranking).

split.DEV (choose): daily results 2018-03-05 -> 2022-12-31; challenge start dates 2018-03 -> 2020-12 (full 24 months inside DEV)
split.TEST (judge once): 2023-01-01 -> 2026-10; start dates 2023-01 -> 2024-10. Never used for choosing.
split.HOURLY CHECK: 2022-01 -> 2026-10 on real hourly prices (daily weights replayed hourly; stops / take-profits fill at the hourly close where they trigger, 0.1% slippage)

stage1_signal_and_sizing (each backtest.selection: rank by DEV prop score at default prop settings (risk 1.0 challenge / 0.4 funded, no stop, no take-profit); keep the top 8

reporting: every stage-1 and stage-2 result saved (results/gen52_*.csv); top 10 configurations by DEV score per firm evaluated ONCE on TEST and on the hourly check, next to plain C* (default settings). Trial count ~3,000: a DEV winner that is not also clearly better than plain C* on TEST is reported as not proven.
decision_rule: a configuration is RECOMMENDED only if on TEST it beats plain C* on average net AND on chance of profit, and the hourly check does not reverse that
